[size=4][b] Real Weather
[/b][/size]Real Weather is an add-on for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3203]Weather Machine[/url]﻿, it can either be used as a stand alone, or as a direct add-on to the Weather Machine. When ran in stand alone mode, the mod will function independently and allow you to experience weather events in real time in-game based on the user's physical location. It does this by getting a local weather report based on your area and then uses that data to determine how to set the current weather conditions in game. 

When ran directly along side the Weather Machine, Real Weather will communicate with the Weather Machine and get the data directly from it, rather than manually get the data independently. This means that Real Weather gets the local weather data from the Weather Machine rather than directly and then uses that data to function. You can either run this as a mod or you can run this along side the Weather Machine, it's entirely up to you. The mod affects the way the game generates weather. Rather than have weather be randomly generated by default; the weather in game can change in any given hour (In real hours) and depending on the weather forecast in your location. You could suddenly see the weather outside change dynamically from a bright and sunny day to a sudden rain and gloomy afternoon. It provides players with the level of unexpected feeling that you may not know what will happen next in your farm.

Best of all, this mod is directly supported by it's users, feedback is encouraged and helps me improve the mod and add the features you want to see.
If you have a question or would like to suggest a new possible feature, head to the forums comment section and tell me how we can make Real Weather better. Although, I may not be able to implement every feature requested. I will consider any feature request and depending on the length of time, amount of research required, and or whether it's free or not. I may be able to make this a future feature. or If you just want to tell me how am doing, hey that works too.
